parallel.requirements: Recognized pure Rust 2021, zero dependencies, byte-identical stdout, same CLI behavior, /output Cargo project, and black-box inference from test13_executable.
parallel.plan_and_ownership: Parent probed the binary, launched an eight-area workflow for characterization/spec/implementation/testing/audit, then continued owning the actual implementation and verification locally.
parallel.implementation: Parent created Cargo.toml, test13.rs, and inflection modules implementing byte-oriented ASCII behavior and inflection quirks, with child workflow still in characterization/retry state.
parallel.integration_and_delivery: The final artifact copied for evaluation included the required entrypoint, modules, Cargo files, and compiled binaries; no child code join was required for the passing artifact.
parallel.verification: Parent built both cargo and rustc paths and ran differential checks including a 20464-case corpus; official evaluation then passed 39 of 39 tests.
parallel.unfinished_or_incorrect: No official correctness defect remained, but the workflow was killed with result null and the parent process timed out before producing a final response.

serial.requirements: Recognized the same prompt requirements: pure Rust 2021, standard library only, exact CLI/stdout behavior, Cargo project in /output, and black-box binary probing.
serial.plan_and_ownership: Single agent owned probing, behavior modeling, project creation, build, tests, and final report because workflows and delegation tools were disabled.
serial.implementation: Implemented the same Rust port shape with Cargo.toml, test13.rs, and inflection modules covering pluralize, singularize, case, parameterization, and byte-wise quirks.
serial.integration_and_delivery: Delivered a coherent /output project with root entrypoint, modules, built executable, and release binary with no cross-agent integration step.
serial.verification: Ran documented examples, curated corpus, 6000 fuzz cases, no/empty/extra argument checks, and cargo/rustc binary parity; official evaluation passed 39 of 39.
serial.unfinished_or_incorrect: No observed unfinished task work; the process ended normally with a final response and remaining budget.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: The parallel run recognized the fixed test13 interface, black-box requirement, pure Rust 2021, zero dependencies, and /output Cargo deliverable requirements.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: The serial run worked from the same prompt and recognized the same 13-line byte-identical output contract and /output project placement.
comparison_dimensions.difference: No material requirement difference; both solved the same current official task and passed all evaluator cases.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: The parallel parent launched a workflow that split characterization across eight areas and planned later spec, implement, difftest, fix, and audit phases while the parent also continued independently.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: The serial control had workflows disabled and denied all delegation tools, so one agent owned probing, implementation, testing, and final reporting.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Parallel used broad workflow delegation plus parent self-work; serial used a single continuous owner.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: The workflow gave children a detailed common behavioral contract for the 13 output lines and per-area probing briefs, with no retained evidence of missing task facts or incompatible component contracts.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: The serial agent kept the recovered behavioral model locally and reported the quirks and verification in one final handoff.
comparison_dimensions.difference: The main contrast is not missing or conflicting context; it is the parallel workflow scale and retries relative to the closure budget.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: The parallel parent wrote the Rust modules, Cargo manifest, entrypoint, and built a byte-oriented port while the workflow remained in characterization.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: The serial agent also wrote the Rust project and modules directly, without child integration or returned subagent code.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Implementation artifacts converged on the same deliverable shape; parallel child work did not need to be joined into the final artifact.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: The workflow aggregate never returned a completed result; the workflow state is killed with result null while several children were still progress or retry states.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: The serial lifecycle ended cleanly: return code 0 and a final report that described the completed port and verification.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Parallel had a failed workflow lifecycle and empty final response; serial closed normally.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: The final copied artifact contains Cargo.toml, test13.rs, inflection modules, and built outputs; no concrete write collision or overwrite was evidenced.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: The serial artifact contains the same required source/module/build structure and copied cleanly for evaluation.
comparison_dimensions.difference: No material integration-state defect separates the passing artifacts; parallel process risk came from background workflow lifecycle rather than file collision.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: The parallel parent performed local build and broad differential checks, and the official evaluator later passed 39 of 39 tests.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: The serial agent performed curated examples, fuzz checks, extra-argument and cargo/rustc parity checks, and the official evaluator passed 39 of 39 tests.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Both verified sufficiently for the official outcome; parallel workflow verification did not finish, but parent-side verification and official evaluation passed.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: The parallel process returned 143 after 2399.544 seconds, provider retry reason was agent_timeout with zero remaining budget, and process_ok was false.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: The serial process returned 0 after 1756.813 seconds with 641 seconds remaining and process_ok true.
comparison_dimensions.difference: This is the concrete process discordance: parallel passed official tests but exhausted its process budget and did not produce a final response; serial passed and closed normally.

outcome_analysis.explanation: There is no discordant official outcome. The current completed cell/status.json evaluations report both parallel and serial as solution_passed true with 39 of 39 tests passed. The material difference is process-level: parallel used an eight-area workflow that stalled, retried, consumed child budget, and was killed before normal final response, while serial completed in one process with remaining budget.
parallel_contributors: Parent-side independent probing, implementation, and differential testing produced a passing artifact despite the killed workflow.
serial_contributors: Single-agent ownership avoided workflow lifecycle overhead and ended with a normal final report.
ordinary_implementation_differences: No ordinary implementation defect explains an outcome gap because both official artifacts passed.
